PQ: Mean object-level exp(-endpoint_error_squared/(2*150^2)); correct exit state/side=1, mismatch=0. Missing/invalid object forecasts receive zero under the frozen scorer; explicit provider-error probes are excluded as missing requests. Not percentage accuracy.
intervals: Whole-layout cluster percentile bootstrap; both directions and all goals resampled together. Seeds/draw counts recorded per estimate.
main: Frozen historical 1641-task membership intersected with complete, prediction-reconciled replacement records across all three main models.
transfer: Frozen historical 118-task membership; require complete full/retry/JSON probes. Terminal placements must be at least 40px from every executed action, and early placements at least 40px from the first action in each arm.
robotics: Separate canonical 132-task extension; transfer uses its own valid untried-probe population.
feedback: Full minus retry paired on the same failed first action. JSON has its own initial action and is a representation control.
stopping: Legacy main-model branches absorb immediate shared success; after first failure, status-hidden branches continue to eight. ER2 status-hidden branches always continue to eight.
human_data: No participant data or idealized human estimates are used.
